faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.a1: Go to the Stations tab, click "+ Add New Station", enter the station name, and assign a staff member if needed. The QR code is generated instantly and can be printed or simulated.
faq.a2: Nexora stations send tips directly to the technician's connected Venmo, Zelle, Cash App, or VLINKPAY address. Funds go straight to their account without processing delays or owner intervention.
faq.q3: How to set up VLINKPAY Wallet?
faq.a3: Navigate to Settings -> Profile tab, scroll down to Payout Methods, and enter your VLINKPAY Wallet identifier. Once verified, customers will see VLINKPAY as a direct tipping option.
faq.a4: You can order custom laser-engraved NFC wooden stands or tabletop cards directly from the Manage Plan / Subscriptions tab, or by contacting our support team with your salon station count.
faq.q5: How do my customers tip without an app?
faq.a5: Customers scan the station QR code with their phone camera — no app download required. They choose a tip amount, select their preferred payment method (Venmo, Zelle, Cash App, or VLINKPAY), and complete the payment in their existing wallet app.
faq.q6: When do tips arrive in my technician's account?
faq.a6: Tips go directly from the customer to the technician's connected payout account. There is no hold or batching by Nexora — funds appear as soon as the customer's payment app confirms the transfer, typically within minutes.
faq.q7: Can I use Nexora Touch with my existing POS system?
faq.a7: Yes. Nexora Touch runs alongside your existing POS — it handles tipping and reviews at each station without replacing your checkout system. Your POS continues to process service payments; Nexora captures tips and feedback via QR codes at each workstation.
faq.q8: What happens if a customer leaves a 1-star review?
faq.a8: Low ratings are routed to you privately first so you can respond before they appear publicly. You receive a notification with the review details and can address the concern directly with the customer or your team.
faq.q9: How do I add or remove a technician from my roster?
faq.a9: Go to Staff in your dashboard. To add a technician, click Invite Staff and share the join link or QR code. To remove someone, open their profile and deactivate or remove them from your roster — their tip history remains in your records.
faq.q10: Is there a contract or can I cancel anytime?
faq.a10: Nexora Touch has no long-term contract. You can cancel your subscription at any time from Manage Plan. Your account stays active through the end of your current billing period.

sections.title: 1. Introduction
sections.body: NEXORA TOUCH LLC ("Nexora", "we", "us", or "our") operates the NEXORA TOUCH platform — a digital tipping and review service for service businesses. This Privacy Policy describes how we collect, use, and share information when you use our Services. By using our Services, you agree to the practices described in this Policy.

sections.title: 2. Information We Collect
sections.body: Information you provide: account details (name, email, phone number), business information (for merchants), and content you upload (profile photos, business logos). Information collected automatically: usage data, IP address, device and browser information, and session activity collected through our platform and Google Analytics. Customer interactions: when a customer uses the tip flow as a guest, we record anonymous session data (touch point accessed, tip amount, rating). We do not collect the customer's name, phone number, or payment information.

sections.title: 3. How We Use Your Information
sections.body: We use collected information to:
items: Manage accounts and communicate with users
Detect fraud and enforce our Terms of Service

sections.title: 4. How We Share Your Information
sections.body: We do not sell your personal information. We share information only with trusted third-party service providers that assist us in operating the platform, including analytics, email delivery, push notifications, and cloud infrastructure. These providers are contractually bound to use your information only as necessary to perform services on our behalf. We may also disclose information to comply with legal obligations or to protect the rights and safety of our users.

sections.title: 5. Payment Information
sections.body: Nexora does not collect, store, or process payment information of any kind. Tips are sent directly between customers and staff through third-party payment applications. We have no access to financial credentials, bank account numbers, or card details.

sections.title: 6. Data Retention
sections.body: We retain your personal information only as long as necessary to provide the Services or as required by law. You may request deletion of your account and data at any time by contacting support@nexoratouch.com.

sections.title: 7. Your Rights
sections.body: Depending on your location, you may have the right to access, correct, delete, or port your personal data, and to object to or restrict certain processing.
items: EU/EEA users (GDPR): access, rectification, erasure, portability, restriction, and objection
California residents (CCPA): right to know, delete, correct, and opt out of sale (we do not sell data)
sections.note: To exercise your rights, contact support@nexoratouch.com. We will respond within 30 days.

sections.title: 8. Cookies and Tracking
sections.body: We use essential cookies (required for authentication and session management) and analytics cookies (Google Analytics). You may opt out of Google Analytics tracking by installing the Google Analytics Opt-out Browser Add-on or adjusting your browser settings.

sections.title: 9. Children's Privacy
sections.body: Our Services are not directed to children under 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13. If you believe a child has provided us with personal information, contact us at support@nexoratouch.com and we will delete it promptly.

sections.title: 10. Security
sections.body: We implement reasonable technical and administrative safeguards to protect your information, including encrypted data transmission and secure cloud infrastructure. No method of transmission is completely secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.

sections.title: 11. Changes to This Policy
sections.body: We may update this Policy from time to time. Material changes will be communicated via email or in-app notification. Continued use of the Services constitutes acceptance of the updated Policy.

sections.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
sections.body: By accessing or using the NEXORA TOUCH platform, website, or applications (collectively, the "Services"), you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, please discontinue use of the Services. We reserve the right to modify these Terms at any time. Continued use after changes take effect constitutes acceptance of the updated Terms.

sections.title: 2. Description of Services
sections.body: NEXORA TOUCH is a digital tipping and review platform for service businesses, enabling customers to send tips to staff and leave reviews via QR code or NFC. The platform connects merchants, service staff, and customers without acting as a payment intermediary.

sections.title: 3. Eligibility
sections.body: To use the Services, you must be at least 13 years of age and, if registering as a merchant, legally authorized to operate a business in your jurisdiction. By using the Services, you represent that you meet these requirements.

sections.title: 4. User Accounts
sections.body: You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account credentials and for all activity that occurs under your account. Notify us immediately of any unauthorized use at support@nexoratouch.com. Merchants may manage their business profile, staff, and touch points. Staff members own and control their own payment information — merchants cannot view or modify staff payment handles.

sections.title: 5. Payments and Tipping
sections.body: Nexora is a platform only. We do not process, hold, transfer, or guarantee any payments. Tips are sent directly by customers to service staff through third-party payment applications (such as Cash App, Venmo, Zelle, or PayPal). Nexora has no involvement in these transactions. Nexora is not liable for any payment failures, disputes, or financial loss arising from tip transactions between users. Users are responsible for resolving payment disputes directly with the other party or their chosen payment application. Staff are responsible for ensuring their payment information is accurate and for complying with any applicable tax obligations on tips received.

sections.title: 6. Subscription Plans
sections.body: Merchant access to platform features is governed by the subscription plan in effect at the time of use. Plan details, pricing, and feature limits are available at the point of purchase. We reserve the right to update pricing with prior notice.

sections.title: 7. Prohibited Conduct
sections.body: You agree not to:
items: Provide false, fraudulent, or misleading information
Upload malicious code or attempt unauthorized access
Use the platform for any illegal purpose
Create multiple accounts to circumvent platform limits

sections.title: 8. Intellectual Property
sections.body: All content, software, and trademarks belonging to Nexora remain our property. By uploading content to the platform, you grant us a limited, non-exclusive license to display that content solely for the purpose of providing the Services.

sections.title: 9. Disclaimer of Warranties
sections.body: THE SERVICES ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY KIND. WE DISCLAIM ALL WARRANTIES, EXPRESS OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND FITNESS FOR A PARTICULAR PURPOSE. WE DO NOT WARRANT THAT THE SERVICES WILL BE UNINTERRUPTED, ERROR-FREE, OR THAT ANY THIRD-PARTY PAYMENT APPLICATION WILL FUNCTION AS EXPECTED.

sections.title: 10. Limitation of Liability

OUR TOTAL LIABILITY SHALL NOT EXCEED THE AMOUNTS PAID BY YOU IN THE 12 MONTHS PRIOR TO THE CLAIM, OR USD $100, WHICHEVER IS GREATER.

sections.title: 11. Indemnification

sections.title: 12. Termination

tooltips.w2: Formal employee. The salon withholds taxes from every paycheck and issues Form W-2 by Jan 31.
tooltips.contractor1099: Independent contractor. No tax is withheld — they pay self-employment tax (~15.3%) themselves and receive Form 1099-NEC if paid $600 or more in a year.
tooltips.boothRenter: Rents a chair/booth from the salon, sets their own prices, and keeps their own service income. Pays rent to the owner and does NOT receive a 1099.
tooltips.w9: IRS form a 1099 contractor fills in to provide their tax ID (SSN or EIN). Collect it before the first payment — a missing W-9 blocks Final Export.
tooltips.w4: IRS form a W-2 employee fills in for filing status, dependents, and extra withholding. Missing or stale (from a prior tax year) can block Lock Tax Year if the owner requires it.

tooltips.highPriority: An unresolved issue that blocks Final Export — e.g. missing W-9, payout dispute, or a high-risk expense without a receipt.
tooltips.businessUsePercent: For expenses used both personally and for business (phone, car, internet): the share used for business. Only that share is deductible.
tooltips.deductible: The portion of this expense that reduces taxable income (amount × business-use %).
